newsitem.title: UK: Xenova, Bristol-Myers to develop new drugs.
newsitem.headline: Xenova, Bristol-Myers to develop new drugs.

text.p: Britain's Xenova Group Plc and Bristol-Myers Squibb Co of the U.S. on Monday announced they had entered into a research collaboration for the discovery of new drugs.
Under the terms of the agreement, Xenova will screen its microbial extract library.
Bristol-Myers Squibb will provide the target technology, undertake the pharmaceutical development and marketing of compounds resulting from the collaboration.
In turn, Xenova will receive research, milestone and royalty payments.

"We believe our library will provide Bristol-Myers Squibb with a wide range of diverse chemicals not available elsewhere for screening as drug leads," Michael Moore, research director of Xenova's discovery division, said in a statement.
